title: Author the GitHub Actions workflow that deploys Fabric artifacts via fabric-cicd on merge to main
description: Write the GitHub Actions workflow that installs fabric-cicd, authenticates as the Service Principal from repository secrets, and publishes the fabric/ artifact definitions to the workspace on merge to main. Deployment logic only — secret configuration and the first live run are task-046.
acceptanceCriteria: A workflow at .github/workflows/deploy-fabric.yml triggers on push to main and supports manual dispatch.
It authenticates via Service Principal using repository secrets, never inline credentials.
It invokes fabric-cicd against fabric/ using the parameter.yml from task-044.
The workflow is inspectable as a dry run — a mode that resolves and reports what would deploy without publishing.
Workflow YAML is syntactically valid (verified locally, e.g. via actionlint or an equivalent parse check).
notes: Authored .github/workflows/deploy-fabric.yml: triggers on push to main (always dry-run) and workflow_dispatch (dry_run + publish boolean inputs, defaults safe). Authenticates as the task-043 Service Principal via azure-identity ClientSecretCredential fed from AZURE_CLIENT_ID/AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET/AZURE_TENANT_ID/FABRIC_WORKSPACE_ID repo secrets (no inline credentials). Constructs fabric_cicd.FabricWorkspace against fabric/ with environment=DEV and item_type_in_scope matching fabric/parameter.yml (Notebook, DataPipeline, Dataflow, SemanticModel, Lakehouse, Report, Warehouse); construction validates parameter.yml and authenticates. Dry-run = construct + read-only _refresh_repository_items/_refresh_deployed_items + report, skip publish_all_items; publish mode calls publish_all_items and uploads a JSON summary artifact. API signatures verified against installed fabric-cicd 1.2.0 (FabricWorkspace.__init__ takes token_credential; publish_all_items is the publish entry point; PARAMETER_FILE_NAME=parameter.yml; ClientSecretCredential is the documented SP credential). Gating enforced via EFFECTIVE_DRY_RUN env = (workflow_dispatch && inputs.publish==true) ? false : true, so push-to-main cannot publish until task-046 flips it. Header comment documents the Fabric->local->Update commit-ordering convention and the one-line change deferred to task-046. YAML validated with actionlint 1.7.12 (prebuilt darwin-arm64 binary) exit 0, no warnings; PyYAML structural parse also confirmed. [Multi-file: 2 files modified] In-scope fix: fabric/parameter.yml header comment pointer corrected from .github/workflows/fabric-deploy.yml (task-043) to .github/workflows/deploy-fabric.yml (task-045). Decisions DEC-007 (dry-run gating) and DEC-008 (ClientSecretCredential auth) recorded.
